query:
SELECT id, source_type, title, authors, publication_year, journal, doi, url, notes, keywords
FROM bibliography_sources
WHERE source_type = 'scientific_paper'
LIMIT 3;

SELECT id, source_type, title, notes, keywords
FROM bibliography_sources
WHERE notes LIKE '%linalool%' OR keywords LIKE '%linalool%' OR title LIKE '%linalool%'
LIMIT 3;
